mainEntity.name: What should an AI lead-generation report show me every week?

acceptedAnswer.text: A useful weekly report should show new prospects, qualification reasons, source dates, confidence, status changes, replies, opt-outs, meetings, and unresolved exceptions. Separate activity metrics from business outcomes so a larger list does not look like success by itself. Include a short explanation of what changed and which records need human attention. Run My AI Biz’s recurring research and consolidated-report examples can help organize these updates around your chosen workflow and decision points.
acceptedAnswer.description: Include new prospects, evidence, confidence, qualification status, replies, opt-outs, meetings, exceptions, and conversions. Add a short list of decisions or corrections needed. Keep activity separate from outcomes so records added do not obscure whether the process creates useful opportunities.
